decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the installation of a new shop front, as shown on drawing numbers, Original Plans: Gun/01, Gun/02 (Part superseded by amended plan) & Gun/05, received 10 July 2006 and Amended Plans: Unnumbered, received 1 September 2006, is recommended for approval as the proposed development satisfactorily complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 All New Development, ENV-B.1.8 Disabled Access, S.4.2 Shop Front Design, and Supplementary Planning Guidance. In this regard the proposed development would not adversely affect the visual quality of the building or the character of the street scene and it would maintain the amenity of surrounding properties and commercial shopping precinct.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
